meta.title: Technical Evaluation Approval and Re-evaluation: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and attempt Technical Evaluation Approval and Re-evaluation, recording whether the action is refused or absent.
Sign in as a Buyer in the same tenant and attempt the same action, recording whether it is available.
Compare the non-Buyer and Buyer outcomes, including tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
